highlights.title: World-Class Underwater Marvels
highlights.subtitle: We take you to the four most legendary and breathtaking snorkeling spots in the Gili Islands.
highlights.spot1Desc: The natural sanctuary of wild green sea turtles. Swim peacefully side-by-side in crystal-clear water.
highlights.spot2Desc: The iconic 48 life-size human sculpture ring by Jason deCaires Taylor, now a blooming coral reef nursery.
highlights.spot3Desc: A pristine blue coral paradise teeming with thousands of colorful tropical fish including Clownfish and Angel fish.
highlights.spot4Desc: Witnessing the breathtaking golden sunset from the open waters with the silhouette of Bali's Mount Agung.

about.title: About Trip Snorkeling Gili Trawangan
about.subtitle: Trusted & Experienced Premier Marine Adventure Operator in 3 Gilis
about.storyTitle: Connecting You to Indonesia's Underwater Sanctuary
about.storyVision: We believe snorkeling is more than spotting marine life; it is about feeling at peace and fostering mutual awareness to protect the Gili coral reefs for generations to come.
about.val1Desc: Every boat is equipped with standardized life jackets, marine first-aid kits, and water-safety certified captains.
about.val2Desc: We educate our guests never to touch or stand on corals, and to maintain a respectful distance from sea turtles.
about.val3Desc: 100% of our boat captains and crew members are native islanders who are friendly, hospitable, and knowledgeable.
